headline: Chicago is running behind; a ground delay program is slowing Seattle arrivals.

items.text: Chicago O'Hare is at 80% on time (within 30 minutes of schedule) so far today, with 460 departed, behind the other hubs. The other six hubs reporting are at 89% on time or better.
The FAA has a ground delay program in effect for flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT. Those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 32 minutes and up to 82 minutes.
The FAA's operations plan lists possible ground stops or ground delay programs for flights into Newark tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET and San Francisco tomorrow after 7:00 AM PT; neither is in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, since a ground delay program holds flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT.
